Q7.answer:
(a) MSPB hears. Notice 2026-08-31 is before 2026-09-02, so OPM appeals rule does not apply; MSPB continues to adjudicate RIF appeals where notice issued before effective date. Documents bearing: 2026-15665 main rule DATES (notice before = earlier regulations), 2026-15666 appeals rule DATES (applies only notice on/after 2026-09-02), 2026-17338 appeals correction (same eff. date/trigger), 2026-16456 MSPB rule DATES and B (continues RIF appeals, accepts where notice before), 2026-17335 main correction (eff. 2026-09-02, authority/cross-references, does not change trigger).
(b) OPM hears (notice 2026-10-19 on/after 2026-09-02). File through OPM electronic filing system identified on OPM website, unless good cause and OPM approval for other method; not email/postal. 351.902(a). Deadline: 30 calendar days from effective date 2026-12-18, first day counted is day after, 351.902(b)(1): Dec 19 day1 ... Dec 31 day13, Jan 17 2027 day30. Jan 17 2027 is Sunday, so period includes first workday after: Jan 18 2027, by 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time under 351.902(b). If Jan 18 is a federal holiday, first workday would be Jan 19 - documents do not list holidays.
(c) Prove by preponderance 351.901(b): timeliness, OPM jurisdiction, agency failed to comply with applicable statute or OPM regulation governing RIF under part 351, and prejudice (caused appealed action or loss of materially more favorable outcome). No hearing as of right: review based solely on written record unless OPM determines hearing necessary and efficient (record insufficient on material fact or material witness credibility dispute), 351.905(c).
(d) Rule: 351.901(c)(2) RIF action/matter relating to appeal may not be raised under negotiated grievance procedure or contested through grievance arbitration; (c)(1) as corrected sole/exclusive in this subpart. Preamble 49244-49245: does not retroactively invalidate existing CBAs; when renegotiated, governmentwide rule limits duty/ability to bargain for inconsistent direct RIF appeal process; effect of existing provisions/negotiability/ULP remain for chapter 71 forum.
(e) No. 351.901(c)(4): party cannot obtain judicial review of decision under subpart; 351.909(e) no further appeal of final decision. Collateral claims in preserved forums are distinct.
(f) Yes, potentially under tolling 351.902(b)(3): collateral complaint timely filed before filing period expired with OSC (entity in 351.901(c)(3)), final decision materially affects retention standing (OPM in sole discretion determines materiality; correction would have changed standing), may file within 30 calendar days after decision becomes final/no longer subject to further administrative review. Final decision 2027-03-10: day1 Mar 11, day30 Apr 9 2027, by 11:59 p.m. ET via e-filing, subject to OPM materiality determination.
(g) Appeals rule DATES at 49230: applies only to RIF action for which agency issues specific RIF notice under 351.802 on/after 2026-09-02.
Q7.uncertainty: Federal-holiday status of 2027-01-18 is not in documents; counting above follows weekend extension in 351.902(b)(1) and flags holiday issue.
